decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (0462_00_001; 0462_00_010; 0462_98PD_101; 0462_98PD_103; 0462_98_201;0462_98_203; Planning Statement; received 27/10/2017; 0462_100_003a; 0462_00_004a; 0462_00_010a; 0462_00_101a; 0462_00_103a; 0462_98_101; 0462_98_103; Received 04/12/2017.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Erection of a three storey rear extension and a two storey side extension. Installation of roof windows and alterations to front elevation
